topics.title: New Year’s Eve Relationship Discussions
topics.summary: During a New Year’s Eve conversation, individuals discuss past relationships involving lesbian themes including attempts at intimacy with women and marital dissatisfaction. References are made to awkward encounters within a wedding setting featuring a ‘Frankenstein blonde,’ personal frustrations, television appearances, and the challenges of revealing one's sexuality to family.

topics.title: Kennedy New Year's Eve Party
topics.summary: During a chaotic New Year’s Eve party hosted by Senator Ted Kennedy, attendees wore bizarre costumes including Tyrannosaurus sex and Kermit the vagina. The senator himself dressed as a purple dinosaur while his wife played a little girl singing about love, amidst accusations of racism regarding Michael Jackson's molestation allegations.

topics.title: Stern Discusses Network Negotiations
topics.summary: Howard Stern explores a potential deal with Fox and Murdoch, grappling with logistical challenges like his daily broadcast schedule and exploring options for adapting to nightly programming while addressing past conflicts with Chevy Chase and Terry Bradshaw. The conversation includes discussions about creative freedom, media control, and personal relationships.

topics.title: Gumbel’s Holiday Broadcast – Unscripted Remarks
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Greg Gumbel made inappropriate comments about Terry, including fantasies and racially charged remarks. He then discussed children's access to toy guns and briefly referenced controversial statements from Senator Ernest Hollings regarding Africans.

topics.title: Political Scandals & Heroic Children
topics.summary: During a broadcast, hosts discussed stereotypes of cannibalism within African communities and allegations against political figures like Bill Clinton and Kevin Elder’s son. They also highlighted stories involving heroic children performing the Heimlich maneuver to save siblings' lives, alongside discussions about Alec Baldwin advocating for horse-drawn cab regulations.

topics.title: Holiday Radio Broadcast and Listener Requests
topics.summary: During the broadcast, hosts discuss Viacom-Barry Diller negotiations alongside a chaotic segment involving cable system issues and listener requests for holiday music CDs, including an impromptu performance of Nancy Sirianni-Martling’s Christmas song with a frantic plea to order it.
